title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space to Bind Them All
description: Aligns six modalities — images, text, audio, depth, thermal, IMU data — in a shared embedding space using only image-paired data for each modality. Audio-text alignment is never trained directly, yet emerges from both modalities being aligned to images. Enables zero-shot cross-modal retrieval (find images from audio, find audio from text) without paired training data.
authors: Girdhar, El-Nouby, Liu, Singh, Alwala, Joulin, Misra (Meta AI)
